name: deal into ordered piles then merge
mechanism: deal elements onto the leftmost pile whose top is not smaller (found by halving over pile tops), creating a new pile when none qualifies, then merge the piles; the pile count is the longest increasing subsequence length

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Patience sorting' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting:

fails_when: the merge step dominates on random input
